summary.text: Chi Ossé represents the 36th District on the New York City Council, which includes Bedford-Stuyvesant and North Crown Heights in Brooklyn.
His Council biography says he was elected in 2021 at age 23 as the Council's youngest member and co-chairs the Brooklyn Delegation and the LGBTQIA+ Caucus.

paragraphs.text: Ossé entered politics as an organizer and prominent figure in the Black Lives Matter movement, according to his Council biography.
It says that in his first term he passed legislation to provide anti-overdose medication to bars and nightlife venues and a package of bills on rats.
It also credits him with passing Intro 360, the Fairness in Apartment Rental Expenses (FARE) Act, which makes the party who hires a broker responsible for the broker's fee.
